label: GO step choosing a2 late in the episode (trial >= ~85)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (zero at D1/D2), only when the policy picks a2 (98% of mass on model_act==2), and only late in the episode: none before trial 60, rate rises steeply from trial 70 to 99 (73% of mass in trials 90-99). It is also tied to low model value (81% of mass in the lowest value bin), which probably tracks the end of the episode. Magnitude is higher when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 32% of the predicate hits but ~50% of the mass) and at the very last trials. It does not fire on a1 choices, on D1/D2, or before trial ~65. The trial cutoff is soft, so the onset varies by episode: a lower cutoff (75) gives mass recall 0.98 but precision 0.50, and 85 is the best F1 (dev 0.78). Uses no future variables: model_act is the policy choice of the agent at this step.
